response.justification: The candidate is a strong, experienced full-stack/web software engineer with broad language exposure (JS/TS, DLang, PHP, Swift, Java, C#) but shows no evidence of the core requirements for this role: native-level Japanese proficiency, embedded/UNIX C development, Linux kernel investigation or modification, or any network security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, Captive Portal, switch chips). His experience is almost entirely in high-level web/mobile/backend platforms rather than embedded firmware or security-focused systems programming.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, senior-level software engineering experience across multiple domains and languages
Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, and workshop/training delivery skills
Fluent English communication and strong open-source/community engagement
concerns: No indication of Japanese language proficiency, which is a hard requirement for this role
No demonstrated experience with Linux kernel internals, embedded C/UNIX development, or chip-vendor SDKs
No background in network security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, Captive Portal) or L2/L3 switch operations

key_factors.factor: No network security or switch domain expertise
